revision_reason: Formal correspondence audits now provide independent controls for Nessé~Nisé, Tſchiper~Chipér and Selí~Sirí, upgrading all three to grade A architecture. Blue-green remains A- pending a dedicated historical-root mapping audit.

grading_scale.A: historical source plus independent modern Rarámuri evidence, with major formal differences controlled by correspondence evidence external to the target candidate; important historical questions may still remain
grading_scale.A-: independent historical-modern support is established, but a major root-mapping, phonological or semantic-granularity problem remains insufficiently controlled
grading_scale.B: strong historical-modern match but modern evidence independence is unresolved or concentrated in one lineage
grading_scale.B-: promising candidate with source-internal modern support but lacking independent modern replication

key_change: For the principal lexical candidates, source independence is no longer the limiting factor. Nessé~Nisé, Tſchiper~Chipér and Selí~Sirí now also have independent formal correspondence controls. The remaining targeted bottleneck is blue-green root mapping and unresolved candidate-specific historical morphology/etymology.
research_rule: Grade A does not mean demonstrated cognacy. It means that source independence and the main observed formal differences are controlled by evidence external to the target item. Publication-level cognacy still requires an explicit comparative argument and human linguistic review.
